fields.name: Defer Mode
fields.type: CS Shared SB Increment Defer Mode

GPU_SHAREABILITY_FAULT.description: A cache has detected that the same line has been accessed as both shareable and non-shareable memory from inside the GPU.

SYSTEM_SHAREABILITY_FAULT.description: A cache has detected that the same line has been accessed as both shareable and non-shareable memory from outside the GPU.

kbase_memory_rules.description: At least one CPU or GPU protection bit must be set.
GPU executable pages cannot be GPU writable (W^X).
Executable BOs live in EXEC_VA_ZONE (1ULL << 47) and cannot use BASE_MEM_SAME_VA.
BASE_MEM_COHERENT_SYSTEM is rejected on non-ACE SoCs (such as MT6878 where system_coherency == COHERENCY_NONE == 31).
BASE_MEM_CSF_EVENT cannot be combined with BASE_MEM_COHERENT_LOCAL or BASE_MEM_COHERENT_SYSTEM_REQUIRED.
BASE_MEM_CSF_EVENT requires BASE_MEM_SAME_VA | BASE_MEM_PROT_CPU_RD | BASE_MEM_PROT_CPU_WR and rejects GROW_ON_GPF, TILER_ALIGN_TOP, PROTECTED, andUNCACHED_GPU.

kbase_memory_rules.constraint: On non-CPU-coherent SoCs (!kbase_device_is_cpu_coherent), BASE_MEM_CSF_EVENT clears KBASE_REG_GPU_CACHED and KBASE_REG_SHARE_IN | KBASE_REG_SHARE_BOTH, setting AS_MEMATTR_INDEX_NON_CACHEABLE.
kbase_memory_rules.description: Consequently, BASE_MEM_CSF_EVENT BOs cannot be aliased via KBASE_IOCTL_MEM_ALIAS and must never be accessed with mixed shareability (e.g. LOAD_MULTIPLE/STORE_MULTIPLE + SYNC_ADD.system on the same 64B cache line).
KBASE_IOCTL_MEM_ALIAS rejects any target BO that lacks KBASE_REG_GPU_CACHED (including any BASE_MEM_CSF_EVENT or BASE_MEM_UNCACHED_GPU BO) with -ENOMEM (errno=12).
